primary.verdict: The linear reconstruction improved the chronological validation slice but was worse than the raw sensor on the frozen later-time holdout. Random-fold or earlier-period success does not establish later-period transfer for this site.

reserve.verdict: The dependency-light fixed-effect reconstruction has materially variable held-block error. It does not establish stable block transfer and is not equivalent to the published mixed model.

method_learning: The runtime preflight, explicit reconstruction boundary, chronological/held-block partitions, and reserve requirement prevented a validation-only improvement from becoming a final performance claim. This supports the value of the governed process for this bounded case, not autonomous discovery or a cross-domain scientific result.
prohibited_claims: No universal claim about low-cost sensor calibration.
No causal or real-world spillover claim.
No equivalence claim to either published workflow.
next_permitted_action: Issue a bounded System-1 method evaluation and redesign decision; retain all packets, runtime failures, validation results, and final receipts.
